<thought>Since the previous search returned no templates, I will broaden the criteria by removing the ketone from the broken functional groups and also omit the formed functional group filter, keeping the bond changes that define the cyclization. This should retrieve any template that matches the intramolecular Michael addition forming a flavanone.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1C(C2=CC=CC=C2)C3=CC=CC=C3O1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aromatic hydroxyls"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6", "6-8"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
